services.name: Adult Program - Spring 2016
services.desc: Learn tennis from scratch - receive a free PRINCE tennis racquet with 6 hours of instruction. Participants will be taught the proper grips and technique and will build confidence with their strokes through a variety of game situations. The Drill and Play program is the next step after the ABC’s and is for players that can have a 3 to 5 shot rally and can start a point fairly consistently with their serve. The program will cover a variety of game situations as well as court positioning and strategy. Topspin and slice will also be introduced.
